source_snapshot.procedure: Run network SST through mapped PCIe NIC paths for 12 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: Throughput above 80% of bandwidth and no SEL error.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds slot/root-port mapping, per-path oracle, low-rail/dew-point controls and recovery.

old_problem: Pending values were slot topology, peer/profile, 80% calculation and cold/low-rail limits; they are executable bindings.
disposition_reason: ED-03 binds topology/profile, ED-05 preserves every Ethernet path, ED-09 keeps card/cable/chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves 12 hours, and ED-15 requires a signed per-path 80% formula.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row50 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3086 and actual next row51/history3087 were read.
Every applicable physical slot is mapped to NIC/BDF/netdev/root port/lane and peer; one path or aggregate result is insufficient.
Per-path throughput is correlated with negotiated link, AER and measured -5% rail to expose low-voltage retraining.
Dew-point control, rail ramp/undershoot abort and dry warm-up are mandatory; no action ran.

test_case.test_name: All PCIe-slot network stress for 12 hours at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify every applicable PCIe/NIC path sustains its signed traffic and >80% floor under cold/low-rail margin without link, AER or platform failure.
required_package: 0C dew-point/-5% rail ramp and abort/recovery profile
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, verify every mapped link, execute the complete 12-hour SST slot matrix, record per-path throughput/link/AER/environment, then warm dry and restore rails/topology.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable path completes required coverage above its signed 80% floor with stable negotiated links and no disallowed AER/kernel/SEL event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires every mapped slot/path, full duration and per-path calculation; one NIC, aggregate throughput or nominal-condition evidence cannot pass.
safety_gate: Controlled low-rail ramp with calibrated undershoot limit
Abort on condensation, link/AER, electrical or thermal fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop on a path/environment fault, preserve evidence, return rails nominal, warm/dry before access, restore topology and do not auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: Sources align on every-slot cold/low-rail network coverage.

blocked.reason: A safe parameterized manual method is defined.
